name: Naive PPO
tagline: PPO with no constraint handling: Lagrange multiplier stays at 0 and the cost advantage is dropped from the surrogate.
diff_from_baseline: Schulman et al., 'Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms' (arXiv:1707.06347, 2017). Lower-bound reference for safe RL: pure unconstrained PPO with cost completely ignored. Establishes maximum reward attainable with no safety mechanism.

name: PPO-Lagrangian
tagline: Adam-optimized Lagrange multiplier: $\lambda$ is a clamped torch parameter trained to push reward when $J_c$ exceeds the cost limit.
diff_from_baseline: Ray, Achiam & Amodei, 'Benchmarking Safe Exploration in Deep Reinforcement Learning' (2019, OpenAI Safety Gym); standard PPO-Lagrangian implementation as in OmniSafe `ppo_lag.py`. Canonical safe-RL reference.

name: PID Lagrangian
tagline: PID controller for the Lagrange multiplier: combines proportional, integral, and (delayed) derivative responses to cost violations with EMA smoothing.
formula: $$\delta = J_c - d,\;\; I \leftarrow \max(0, I + k_i\,\delta),\;\; \Delta_p \leftarrow 0.95\,\Delta_p + 0.05\,\delta,\;\; D = \max(0, c_d - c_d^{(-10)}),\;\; \lambda = \max(0, k_p\Delta_p + I + k_d D),\;\; A_{\mathrm{surr}} = \frac{A_r - \lambda A_c}{1+\lambda}$$
diff_from_baseline: Stooke, Achiam & Abbeel, 'Responsive Safety in Reinforcement Learning by PID Lagrangian Methods' (ICML 2020). PID feedback controller for $\lambda$ that reacts faster than Adam-style integral-only updates and damps oscillations near the cost limit.
